_invented: IGS's event schedule, parameters and rewards never reached the cabinet: all of this file is the stand-in server's own.  Texts are the game's (boards.json).

dates._: per kind: [start, end] as YYYY-MM-DD; a kind not listed runs from the 1st to the last day of this month

notice: 歡迎來到鼓王的國度！線上排行、活動看板與龍族捕獲由 igs-online 提供。

holiday_titles._: holiday kind -> title field; index 0 at the first count of holiday cursors hit during the event, index 1 at the second

contest_titles._: contest kind -> title field; index i while the member's place is at most places[i]

contest_cursor._: taking part in the Knights' contest (13) unlocks this cursor (Knight Cursor)

registration_cursors._: signing up while board 18 runs unlocks these cursors (Yellow / White Chick)

dragons._: board 14: up to 3 dragons in song select, shared by every cabinet; kind 0..8 picks the dragon's song (141..149), 9 a 20-point dragon.  The score a player reaches on the dragon's stage is the damage.  Catching one sets that member's grade 8 for (difficulty, kind); others who fought it get 9 (lost).

dragon2._: board 22: one world dragon at a time, groups 2..4 of three on InfoDragon's board
